comments.author: Tonofash
comments.body_html: I know some of these features are in the Medical Attention mod by jbs but will there be an option to fix fractures or blacked out parts? I kinda want a reason to use other meds besides the AFAK or Grizzly.

comments.author: NoNeedName
comments.body_html:
Hi, maybe I don’t understand quite well what you’re asking, but to fix black parts there are the cms and surv-kit, for broken bones there are the splints.
The reason you want to use other meds besides afak is because it doesn’t fix broken bones or restore blacked parts.
The reason you want to use other meds besides grizzly is because it doesn’t restore blacked parts and it’s 4 slots.
